questions.passage: Overall, playful people do not take themselves too seriously, and they seem to know when to take it easy and when to be serious.
questions.prompt: Which statement best preserves the description of playful people?
options: They never treat any situation seriously.
They avoid every responsibility regardless of context.
They always worry about presenting themselves as important.
They do not overvalue their own seriousness and seem able to adjust to the situation.
questions.promptZh: 哪项最保留这句对有玩心者的描述？
optionsZh: 他们对任何情况都不认真。
他们不论情境都回避所有责任。
他们总担心怎样显得重要。
他们不过度严肃地看待自己，似乎能按情况调整态度。
analyses: A when to be serious 明确保留认真时刻。
B 没有回避所有责任的说法。
C 与 do not take themselves too seriously 相反。
D 保留不自视过重和何时轻松、何时认真两方面；seem 也不能改成每次必然判断正确。

evidence.quote: they seem to know when to take it easy and when to be serious.

vocabulary.context: 与 be serious 对照，强调按情境调整，不是永远不努力

questions.passage: Jerome Kagan, the late Harvard psychologist, lamented this trend, saying that “the typical scientist during my graduate years went to the basement of the university building, with the help of a graduate student, writing and rewriting a paper reporting an interesting result…two minds and four hands, often with no outside funds, performed all the work. Under these conditions the pride savored if the experiment were successful, or the blend of frustration and sadness if not, was restricted to a pair of agents.
questions.prompt: What feature of the earlier scientific work does Kagan emphasise?
options: A small pair performed the whole process and closely shared the emotions of success or failure.
Hundreds of separate experts each completed one isolated step.
Every experiment had guaranteed success and abundant funding.
Graduate students were never involved in producing papers.
questions.promptZh: Kagan 强调早期科研的什么特点？
optionsZh: 一小对人完成整个过程，密切共享成败情绪。
几百位分开的专家各做一道孤立步骤。
每次实验必成功且资金充足。
研究生从未参与论文。
analyses: A two minds and four hands...all the work 与成败情绪 restricted to a pair 对应。
B 这是他之后对大团队的对照，不是 earlier work 的描述。
C often with no outside funds，且明确允许失败。
D help of a graduate student 明确有参与。引语是 Kagan 对其研究生年代的回顾，不是对所有年代每项科研的普遍测量。

evidence.quote: two minds and four hands, often with no outside funds, performed all the work.
was restricted to a pair of agents.

questions.passage: These emotions are seriously diluted when hundreds of experts design experiments to be executed by teams.”
questions.prompt: What does “diluted” mean in Kagan’s comparison?

questions.promptZh: Kagan 的比较中 diluted 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 加入测定体积的水。
证明每位成员完全没有情绪。

B seriously diluted 不等于所有人毫无情绪。
C 当前句谈情绪，非把情绪直接计为论文数。
D 承接上段一对人共享成败，再对照数百专家及执行团队。不能把 Kagan 的评价冒充测量了每位大团队成员的情绪。

questions.passage: For instance, he worried that the division of labor would make humans one-dimensional: “Division of labour seizes upon, not only the economic, but every other sphere of society, and everywhere lays the foundation of that all engrossing system of specializing and sorting men, that development in a man of one single faculty at the expense of all other faculties.”
questions.prompt: What imbalance does Marx fear in the development of a person?
options: Every faculty develops equally through specialization.
One faculty develops at the cost of the others.
Economic skills decline while all other faculties grow.
Specialization affects economic life but leaves other spheres untouched.
questions.promptZh: Marx 担心人的能力发展出现什么失衡？
optionsZh: 所有能力都通过专门化得到同等发展。
一种能力的发展以其他能力为代价。
经济技能下降，而其他能力全部增长。
专门化影响经济生活，却不涉及其他领域。
analyses: A one single faculty 与 all other faculties 的代价关系不是均衡发展。
B at the expense of 明确指出发展单一能力会牺牲其他能力，这是 Marx 的担忧。
C 颠倒了受益与受损对象，也把 faculty 武断缩成经济技能。
D not only the economic, but every other sphere 扩展了涉及领域，非仅限经济。此处引述理论担忧，不是实验结论。

evidence.quote: that development in a man of one single faculty at the expense of all other faculties.

vocabulary.context: 一种能力的发展挤占其他能力的发展，不是指财务费用
vocabulary.example: She improved her speed at the expense of accuracy.
collocations: at the expense of other faculties

questions.passage: In this manner, we replicated the results from the online assembly experiment: like those in the division of labor condition, participants in the specialized job thought their job would be less interesting than those in the generalist job.
questions.prompt: Which specific similarity does the author cite as a replication?
options: Both studies measured consultants’ long-term careers.
Both studies found every psychological outcome to be identical.
Both studies required participants to assemble real consulting teams.
The specialized condition was judged less interesting than the broader task condition.
questions.promptZh: 作者具体把哪项相似之处称为结果复现？
optionsZh: 两研究都测量顾问的长期职业生涯。
两研究发现每个心理指标结果完全相同。
两研究都要求参与者组建真实咨询团队。
专门化条件被认为比承担较完整任务的条件更少趣味。
analyses: A 一项线上组装、一项假想工作，均非长期从业跟踪。
B 原文在冒号后点明 less interesting，不能扩成全部结果完全相同。
C 没有组建真实咨询团队这一共同任务。
D like those... 与 less interesting...generalist 给出具体复现的趣味性方向。thought their job 表示预测，不是实际任职体验；不要用 replicated 一词抹平设计差别。

questions.passage: Again, participants felt less time pressure after the time-saving service, and the less time pressure they felt, the more happiness they reported.
questions.prompt: What relationship is reported between time pressure and happiness?
options: Greater time pressure was associated with greater happiness.
Lower time pressure went with higher reported happiness.
Time pressure stayed identical after both kinds of spending.
Lower time pressure eliminated every negative feeling.
questions.promptZh: 原文报告时间压力与幸福有什么关系？
optionsZh: 时间压力越大，幸福越高。
时间压力越低，报告的幸福越高。

B less time pressure 与 more happiness 相对应，且幸福是 reported。
C felt less...after the time-saving service 表示时间压力较低，不是两者完全相同。
D less 不等于所有负面感受归零。本句的关系不能单独证明时间压力是幸福的唯一机制。

questions.passage: Hiring someone to do the job might inadvertently rob you of an opportunity to have an interesting experience that could add richness to your life story.
questions.prompt: Which paraphrase best matches the warning about hiring someone?

Paying for the work may unintentionally mean missing a potentially enriching experience.

questions.promptZh: 哪种改写最符合关于雇人代做的提醒？
optionsZh: 雇人会有意消除每个幸福来源。
付费请人做可能无意间让自己错过一段潜在的丰富体验。
每个雇工都阻止雇主学习任何技能。
有趣人生故事只能来自无薪体力劳动。
analyses: A inadvertently 是无意，不是故意；richness 也不能换成所有幸福。
B may、unintentionally、potentially 分别守住 might、inadvertently、could。
C 原文没把受雇者说成蓄意阻止学习的人，也没有 every。
D an opportunity 不是唯一来源，不能加入 only。同义改写题除了保留内容，还要保留可能性和行为意图。
